mapper.sql: FROM agent_run r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT run_id, SUM(prompt_tokens) AS prompt_tokens, SUM(cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read_tokens, SUM(completion_tokens) AS completion_tokens FROM agent_step GROUP BY run_id ) s ON s.run_id = r.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT run_id, COUNT(*) AS call_count, SUM(CASE WHEN stage = 'EXECUTION_ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failures, SUM(elapsed_ms) AS tool_elapsed_sum FROM agent_tool_invocation GROUP BY run_id ) t ON t.run_id = r.id

COUNT(*) AS run_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status <> 'RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finished_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'STOPPED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stopped_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_count, COALESCE(SUM(s.prompt_tokens), 0) AS prompt_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(s.cache_read_tokens), 0) AS cached_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(s.completion_tokens), 0) AS completion_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(t.call_count), 0) AS tool_calls, COALESCE(SUM(t.failures), 0) AS tool_failures, COALESCE(SUM(t.tool_elapsed_sum), 0) AS tool_elapsed, COALESCE(SUM(r.elapsed_ms), 0) AS run_elapsed, MIN(r.created_at) AS first_at
mapper.select:
SELECT CAST(r.created_at AS DATE) AS bucket_day,
NULL AS grp,
WHERE r.created_at >= #{from} AND r.created_at < #{to} GROUP BY CAST(r.created_at AS DATE) ORDER BY bucket_day

SELECT s.model_name AS grp, COUNT(DISTINCT s.run_id) AS run_count, 0 AS finished_count, 0 AS stopped_count, 0 AS failed_count, COALESCE(SUM(s.prompt_tokens), 0) AS prompt_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(s.cache_read_tokens), 0) AS cached_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(s.completion_tokens), 0) AS completion_tokens, 0 AS tool_calls, 0 AS tool_failures, 0 AS tool_elapsed, COALESCE(SUM(s.elapsed_ms), 0) AS run_elapsed, MIN(s.created_at) AS first_at FROM agent_step s JOIN agent_run r ON r.id = s.run_id WHERE r.created_at >= #{from} AND r.created_at < #{to} GROUP BY s.model_name ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(s.prompt_tokens), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(s.completion_tokens), 0) DESC

SELECT CAST(r.created_at AS DATE) AS bucket_day, s.model_name AS model_name, COALESCE(SUM(s.prompt_tokens), 0) AS prompt_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(s.cache_read_tokens), 0) AS cached_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(s.completion_tokens), 0) AS completion_tokens FROM agent_step s JOIN agent_run r ON r.id = s.run_id WHERE r.created_at >= #{from} AND r.created_at < #{to} GROUP BY CAST(r.created_at AS DATE), s.model_name ORDER BY bucket_day, s.model_name

SELECT i.tool_name AS tool_name, COUNT(*) AS call_count, SUM(CASE WHEN i.stage = 'EXECUTION_ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failures, SUM(CASE WHEN i.stage = 'UNKNOWN_TOOL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_tool, SUM(CASE WHEN i.stage = 'VALIDATION_ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS validation_errors, SUM(CASE WHEN i.stage = 'PARSE_ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS parse_errors, SUM(CASE WHEN i.stage = 'REQUEST_REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected, SUM(CASE WHEN i.stage = 'CIRCUIT_OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS circuit_open, COALESCE(SUM(i.elapsed_ms), 0) AS tool_elapsed_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT i.run_id) AS runs FROM agent_tool_invocation i JOIN agent_run r ON r.id = i.run_id WHERE r.created_at >= #{from} AND r.created_at < #{to} GROUP BY i.tool_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, i.tool_name

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.total_tokens), 0) AS run_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(s.prompt_tokens), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(s.completion_tokens), 0) AS step_tokens, SUM(CASE WHEN s.run_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS runs_without_steps, COUNT(*) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN s.cache_read_tokens > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cache_hit_runs, COALESCE(SUM(s.prompt_tokens), 0) AS prompt_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(s.cache_read_tokens), 0) AS cached_tokens FROM agent_run r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT run_id, SUM(prompt_tokens) AS prompt_tokens, SUM(cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read_tokens, SUM(completion_tokens) AS completion_tokens FROM agent_step GROUP BY run_id ) s ON s.run_id = r.id WHERE r.created_at >= #{from} AND r.created_at < #{to}
SELECT DISTINCT s.model_name AS model_name FROM agent_step s JOIN agent_run r ON r.id = s.run_id WHERE r.created_at >= #{from} AND r.created_at < #{to} ORDER BY s.model_name
